name: Cushi
overview: Cushi is a male figure mentioned briefly in the Bible, identified uniquely as the father of Shelamiah. There is no record of his tribe or additional notes about his life or character. His mention is limited to a single reference in Jeremiah 36:14.
namesAndTitles: The name Cushi appears as a proper name in Scripture without any provided meaning or divine attribution. It is simply recorded as a personal name in Jeremiah 36:14.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Cushi as the father of Shelamiah, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family connections or relationships are documented beyond this.
scriptureSignificance: Cushi's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his identification as the father of Shelamiah, who is mentioned in the context of Jeremiah's prophetic ministry. While Cushi himself does not play an active role, his mention helps to situate Shelamiah within the historical and genealogical framework of the text.
